name: sotto-desktop
description: AGN Sales Shield for Windows and Mac: the web app in its own window, hearing the call through the microphone or the computer's sound
author: AGN IT Services

scripts.web: cd ../app && CI=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_SOTTO_SERVER=${SOTTO_SERVER:-https://104-168-48-116.sslip.io} npx expo export --platform web --output-dir ../desktop/web
scripts.watcher: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14.2 native/call-watch.swift -o build/call-watch-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos14.2 native/call-watch.swift -o build/call-watch-x64 && lipo -create build/call-watch-arm64 build/call-watch-x64 -output build/call-watch

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AGN Sales Shield listens to the customer's side of a call to suggest what to say.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: AGN Sales Shield listens to the other side of your Zoom, Google Meet or softphone call to suggest what to say.
